events.handler: event=>{event.preventDefault();if(window.PrototypePreferences?.privacy().replies===false){UI.toast('新的回应已关闭');return;}const text=input.value.trim();if(!text){UI.fieldError(input,'请先写一句回应');input.focus();return;}UI.busy(button,'发送中…',async()=>{if(UI.failNext('moment-comment'))throw new Error('回应没有发送成功，请重试');const latest=find(item.id);if(!latest){UI.toast('这个时刻已删除','error');return false;}if(!PrototypePreferences.sharedContent('moment',latest)){UI.toast('这个时刻不再共同可见，未发送回应保留','error');return false;}const next={...latest,comments:[...(latest.comments||[]),{id:crypto.randomUUID(),text,author:nickname(),createdAt:Date.now(),read:false}]};if(!put(next))return false;item=next;count();replyLeave.commit();await UI.back();return true;});}
